```python
def get_processed_options(policy_file: Dict[str, Any], ignore: Dict[str,
    Any], ignore_severity_rules: Dict[str, Any], exit_code: bool,
    ignore_unpinned_requirements: Optional[bool]=None, project: Optional[
    str]=None) ->Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any], bool, Optional[bool],
    Optional[str]]:
    """
    Process and merge CLI options with policy file settings.
    
    Args:
        policy_file: The policy file dictionary
        ignore: CLI ignore vulnerabilities
        ignore_severity_rules: CLI ignore severity rules
        exit_code: CLI exit code setting
        ignore_unpinned_requirements: CLI ignore unpinned requirements
        project: CLI project name
        
    Returns:
        Tuple of processed options: (ignore, ignore_severity_rules, exit_code, ignore_unpinned_requirements, project)
    """
    ctx = click.get_current_context(silent=True)
    
    # Get parameter sources
    ignore_source = ctx.get_parameter_source('ignore') if ctx else click.core.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
    exit_code_source = ctx.get_parameter_source('exit_code') if ctx else click.core.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
    ignore_unpinned_source = ctx.get_parameter_source('ignore_unpinned_requirements') if ctx else click.core.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
    project_source = ctx.get_parameter_source('project') if ctx else click.core.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
    
    # Process ignore vulnerabilities
    if ignore_source == click.core.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE:
        processed_ignore = ignore
    elif policy_file:
        security_config = policy_file.get('security', {})
        processed_ignore = security_config.get('ignore-vulnerabilities', {})
    else:
        processed_ignore = ignore
    
    # Process severity rules
    if policy_file:
        security_config = policy_file.get('security', {})
        processed_severity_rules = {
            'ignore-cvss-severity-below': security_config.get('ignore-cvss-severity-below', 0.0),
            'ignore-cvss-unknown-severity': security_config.get('ignore-cvss-unknown-severity', False)
        }
    else:
        processed_severity_rules = ignore_severity_rules or {}
    
    # Process exit code
    if exit_code_source == click.core.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE:
        processed_exit_code = exit_code
    elif policy_file:
        security_config = policy_file.get('security', {})
        continue_on_error = security_config.get('continue-on-vulnerability-error', False)
        processed_exit_code = not continue_on_error
    else:
        processed_exit_code = exit_code
    
    # Process ignore unpinned requirements
    if ignore_unpinned_source == click.core.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE:
        processed_ignore_unpinned = ignore_unpinned_requirements
    elif policy_file:
        security_config = policy_file.get('security', {})
        processed_ignore_unpinned = security_config.get('ignore-unpinned-requirements', None)
    else:
        processed_ignore_unpinned = ignore_unpinned_requirements
    
    # Process project
    if project_source == click.core.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE:
        processed_project = project
    else:
        processed_project = project
    
    return (processed_ignore, processed_severity_rules, processed_exit_code, processed_ignore_unpinned, processed_project)
```
